- **Severity:** High
- **CVSS 4.0 Base Score:** **8.5**
- **CVSS 4.0 Vector:** `CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:H/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H`
- **CWE:** [CWE-78](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/78.html), [CWE-116](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/116.html) (CWE-78, CWE-116)
- **Affected versions:** `github.com/netbirdio/netbird` `>= 0.60.0, < 0.74.7` (desktop clients; see Affected platforms)
- **Patched in:** 0.74.7 — https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird/pull/6805
- **Affected component(s):** ssh config injection
- **Reporter:** [@SecurinDisclose](https://github.com/SecurinDisclose) — Arjun Basnet · Securin Inc. — `arjun.basnet@securin.io`


---

## Overview

```go
fmt.Fprintf(w, `Match host "%s" exec "netbird auth ..."`+"\n", peerFQDN)
```

`peerFQDN` is embedded into a double-quoted OpenSSH `Match host` directive
without escaping. A peer whose FQDN contains a `"` breaks out of the quoted
context and can inject arbitrary SSH config directives — including additional
`exec` commands. The next time a user on that machine runs `ssh`, the injected
commands execute locally.

The file written is the system-wide drop-in
`/etc/ssh/ssh_config.d/99-netbird.conf` (on Windows, the same file under
`%PROGRAMDATA%\ssh\ssh_config.d`), not a per-user `~/.ssh/config`. The daemon
writes it with its own privileges, so an injected directive applies to every
user on the host who runs `ssh`.

---

## Affected Location

- `client/ssh/config/manager.go:193` — `Match host "%s" exec "..."` formatting.

---

## Vulnerable Code

```go
fmt.Fprintf(w, `Match host "%s" exec "netbird auth ..."`+"\n", peerFQDN)
```

---

## Reproduction

A peer whose FQDN or hostname carries a `"` is enough: once it reaches the
victim's network map, the generated config breaks out of the quoted pattern
list.

### PoC output

```
=== RUN   TestH28_SSHConfigInjection
    poc_test.go:47: peerFQDN='evil" exec "id > /tmp/pwn" #' rendered as:
        Match host "evil" exec "id > /tmp/pwn" #" exec "netbird auth ..."
    poc_test.go:53: /tmp/pwn contained uid=1000(victim)
--- PASS
```


---

## Impact

The vulnerability enables the attack described in the Overview. Concrete consequences and CIA breakdown are captured in the CVSS 4.0 vector: `CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:H/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H`.

---

## Fix

Fixed in 0.74.7 ([#6805](https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird/pull/6805)).
Peer-supplied names are validated before they reach the config, rather than
escaped on the way out: `buildHostPatterns` in `client/ssh/config/manager.go`
admits an FQDN or hostname only if it is a plain DNS name
(`domain.IsValidDomainNoWildcard`), and skips it with a warning otherwise. That
rejects embedded quotes, whitespace, newlines, the `,` pattern separator, and
the `*` / `?` pattern metacharacters in one check, so no quoted context can be
broken out of and no unintended host can be matched.

## Affected platforms

Desktop clients on Linux, macOS, Windows and FreeBSD. The Android and iOS apps
are not affected: the config target is a system directory the apps cannot write
(`/etc/ssh/ssh_config.d`), the write error is logged and discarded, and neither
app ships an OpenSSH client that would consume the file.

---

## Remediation

1. Validate `peerFQDN` against a strict RFC-1123 hostname regex.
2. Escape `"` and `\` (or reject them) before templating.
3. Prefer non-template config generation (e.g. write via a config API that
   sanitises input).

---

## References & Evidence

- **CWE definitions:** [CWE-78](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/78.html), [CWE-116](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/116.html)
- **CVSS 4.0 calculator:** https://www.first.org/cvss/calculator/4-0#CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:H/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H
- **Fix:** [#6805](https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird/pull/6805)

---

## Credit

Reported by **Arjun Basnet** — [Securin Inc.](https://securin.io) — via GitHub [@SecurinDisclose](https://github.com/SecurinDisclose).
Coordinated disclosure timeline: **90 days** — public disclosure on or after **2026-10-11** unless extended by mutual agreement.

---

## Private Audit Bundle

Full reproduction bundle (labs, PoCs, live-target evidence, cross-referenced advisories) is available at:

**https://github.com/SecurinDisclose/netbird-0.74.3-audit** (private — request read access via GitHub or email `arjun.basnet@securin.io`).

## Coordinated Disclosure

- **Reporter:** [@SecurinDisclose](https://github.com/SecurinDisclose) — Arjun Basnet, Securin Inc.
- **Contact:** `arjun.basnet@securin.io`
- **Public-disclosure deadline:** 2026-10-11 (90 days from 2026-07-13)
